svg.title: How I work
svg.desc: Make the dangerous mistake loud. A query that forgets its tenant should crash in testing, not leak data later. See ShopOS: apps/api/src/db/plugins/tenantGuard.ts. Write the caveat next to the code. The comment on withTransaction says outright when it silently stops being atomic. See ShopOS: apps/api/src/db/transaction.ts. Let the model read and let code decide. The model interprets requests. Measurements come from code, and edits are validated. See BeatAgent: beatagent/editing, DECISIONS.md. Test against the real database. Real migrations run in-process on PGlite, so the security policies get tested too. See The Bluff Club: tests/db. Say what a number was measured on. The BeatAgent README labels its target numbers as coming from synthetic clips. See BeatAgent: README.md, evals/results.
